scenarios: Requirement and scenario coverage is complete
properties.statement: Every exact requirement and scenario is represented and every scenario edge has positive and negative cases.
properties.oracle: Parsed delta-spec identities equal the manifest graph and each scenario edge has both polarities.

scenarios: Affected increment is applied or verified
properties.statement: An affected selection executes each canonical command once and observes every expected exact test identity.
properties.oracle: Selected cases and observed exact identities agree and command identities are unique.

scenarios: Required evidence crosses an authority boundary
properties.statement: Final readiness cannot pass with planned, blocked, skipped, missing, failed or unauthorized evidence.
properties.oracle: The aggregate result preserves the strongest non-passing case state.

properties.statement: Specification or test-source drift invalidates prior evidence before execution.
properties.oracle: Current SHA-256 fingerprints equal the manifest pins.

properties.statement: Duplicate case edges and duplicate execution definitions are rejected while selected commands remain deduplicated.
properties.oracle: Canonical case and command keys are unique and one selected command executes once.

properties.statement: Forward and reverse selectors return only the sorted unique affected graph closure.
properties.oracle: Requirement, owner and matching-path selections are equal while an unrelated path selects nothing.

properties.statement: Rendered operation routes require structural validation, affected execution and final complete execution.
properties.oracle: The canonical templates and rendered config contain the exact evidence-graph routes and do not conflate validation with execution.

scenarios: Consumer requires a newer Go toolchain
properties.statement: Go may use an already-cached required toolchain but dependency and toolchain network access remain disabled.
properties.oracle: Child environment is GOTOOLCHAIN=auto with GOPROXY=off and unavailable execution remains non-passing.
